bot_inbox_closed_state.name: bot_inbox_closed_state
bot_inbox_closed_state.value: ("bot_inbox_items"."status" = 'open' AND "bot_inbox_items"."close_reason" IS NULL AND "bot_inbox_items"."closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("bot_inbox_items"."status" = 'closed' AND "bot_inbox_items"."close_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "bot_inbox_items"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)

bot_pending_notices_shape.name: bot_pending_notices_shape
bot_pending_notices_shape.value: ("bot_pending_notices"."kind" = 'delegation' AND "bot_pending_notices"."delegation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bot_pending_notices"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bot_pending_notices"."status" IS NOT NULL AND "bot_pending_notices"."revision" IS NOT NULL) OR ("bot_pending_notices"."kind" = 'interrupted_turn' AND "bot_pending_notices"."delegation_id" IS NULL AND "bot_pending_notices"."session_id" IS NULL AND "bot_pending_notices"."status" IS NULL AND "bot_pending_notices"."revision" IS NULL)

generated.as: (CASE WHEN kind = 'shell' THEN NULL ELSE kind END)

delegation_history_compacted_text.name: delegation_history_compacted_text
delegation_history_compacted_text.value: "delegation_history"."compacted_at" IS NULL OR ("delegation_history"."title" IS NULL AND "delegation_history"."summary" IS NULL)

delegation_history_scope_counters.name: delegation_history_scope_counters
delegation_history_scope_counters.value: "delegation_history"."usage_scope" IS NULL OR "delegation_history"."input_tokens" IS NOT NULL OR "delegation_history"."output_tokens" IS NOT NULL

delegation_history_tokens.name: delegation_history_tokens
delegation_history_tokens.value: ("delegation_history"."input_tokens" IS NULL OR "delegation_history"."input_tokens" >= 0) AND ("delegation_history"."output_tokens" IS NULL OR "delegation_history"."output_tokens" >= 0) AND ("delegation_history"."cache_read_tokens" IS NULL OR "delegation_history"."cache_read_tokens" >= 0) AND ("delegation_history"."cache_write_tokens" IS NULL OR "delegation_history"."cache_write_tokens" >= 0) AND ("delegation_history"."reasoning_tokens" IS NULL OR "delegation_history"."reasoning_tokens" >= 0) AND ("delegation_history"."total_tokens" IS NULL OR "delegation_history"."total_tokens" >= 0)

delegation_questions_closed_state.name: delegation_questions_closed_state
delegation_questions_closed_state.value: ("delegation_questions"."state" = 'open' AND "delegation_questions"."answered_by" IS NULL AND "delegation_questions"."cancel_reason" IS NULL AND "delegation_questions"."closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("delegation_questions"."state" = 'answered' AND "delegation_questions"."answered_by" IS NOT NULL AND "delegation_questions"."answer_text" IS NOT NULL AND "delegation_questions"."cancel_reason" IS NULL AND "delegation_questions"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("delegation_questions"."state" = 'cancelled' AND "delegation_questions"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "delegation_questions"."answered_by" IS NULL AND "delegation_questions"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
